2. Structural Collapse (Severity 4.0): Strongly supported by the `animal_pose_auditor`, which reported a HIGH artifact risk level (41% low-confidence keypoints) specifically in the front limbs (hands/arms). The visual fusion of hands and stick is a critical structural defect.

The Router did not underestimate these severities. The combination of missing primary subject and severe structural/textual artifacts in the secondary subjects warrants a low score.

The score is higher than the lowest reference (1.0) because the human figures are largely recognizable despite the hand defects, unlike catastrophic structural collapses in lower-quality generations.
